relation_to_v1: same rate as X0-FEE-BINANCE-SPOT-STD 1.0.0 (contracts/fee_schedule_v1.json, unchanged and still valid for every v1 estimate); v2 only adds the structured scope / verification / discount fields required by P2-X1

entries.effective_basis: research adoption date of this schedule version; NOT a venue effective date (no venue date is evidenced)
entries.discounts_note: no BNB fee discount, no VIP tier, no promotion, no referral rebate, no zero-fee pair programme: none is evidenced
entries.source: generic public Binance spot standard-tier knowledge (0.1000 % taker) recorded as a research assumption; NOT the owner's actual account fee; never read from an account, credentials or the private API
entries.applies_to: every Binance spot symbol in the research universe (pair-specific programmes are not modelled)

entries.effective_basis: research adoption date of this schedule version; NOT a venue effective date
entries.source: generic public standard-tier knowledge (0.1000 % maker); UNUSED: every modelled order is a marketable taker (maker orders refused: queue position unobservable)

resolution_rule: an estimate names exactly one fee schedule id@version; within it the entry is the unique (venue, market_type, liquidity_role) match (ambiguity or absence refuses the estimate). There is no implicit 'latest' and no silent default.
substitution_rule: a later verified fee is added as a NEW schedule (new id or new version, new file hash) with account_scope ACCOUNT_SPECIFIC and verification_status VERIFIED_ACCOUNT_RECORD (an owner-provided account fee statement, no credentials handled by research) or VERIFIED_REALIZED_COMMISSIONS (commissions of real fills; only then provenance MEASURED). Old estimates keep their schedule id@version and their estimate_id; nothing is rewritten. A future re-evaluation reports both schedules side by side.
validation: contracts_v2.validate_fee_schedule refuses: missing fields, duplicate entries, negative / non-finite rates, a discount without evidence or on an unverified schedule, an ACCOUNT_SPECIFIC entry that is not verified, MEASURED without realized commissions, and any unverified entry not marked ASSUMED

reconciliation.p2c_labels: identical to p2_research.labels.FEE_BPS_PER_SIDE = 10.0 (P2-C label set unchanged)
reconciliation.p2d0_protocol: identical to the 2 x 10 bps of P2D_ALPHA_RESEARCH_PROTOCOL section 9
